author: GamingBolt
description:
Mortal Shell 2 takes everything Cold Symmetry learned from its predecessor and scales it up considerably. Featuring a longer campaign, new combat tools, and an exorbitance of new dungeons, the sequel looks near-unrecognisable from the first game. 

That said, there are a handful of noted concerns following the game’s recent open beta. We’ll get into those and more – here’s fifteen things you need to know before deciding whether to buy Mortal Shell 2.
title: Mortal Shell 2 - 13 Things You Need To Know Before You Buy

author: GamingBolt
description:
Beast of Reincarnation, Game Freak's latest title, has released to mixed reception. “Only” a 73 Metascore among 60 critical reviews; a “Mixed” rating on Steam at the moment with only 52 percent giving their approval – almost completely down the middle. 

Even the Steam concurrent player count isn't that impressive, peaking at 15,001 (although it is available on Game Pass and console numbers remain unknown). It's enough to make you remember all those months of positive impressions at the opening hours and wonder what happened.
title: Beast of Reincarnation - What The HELL Happened?
